summary: With SB_E2E_BACKGROUND=1, macOS e2e runs open the app as an accessory app with an inactive window so tests never take focus.

reactNativeIos.reason: Only the Electron main process reads the variable; the phone app has no e2e window.

nativeAndroid.reason: Only the Electron main process reads the variable; Android has no e2e window.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No backend endpoint or wire contract changes.

storageDataMigration.reason: No persisted data or migration changes.

updateRelease.reason: Released builds never set the variable, so window behaviour is unchanged for users.

hardware: Frontmost app sampled every 2 s during both runs on a Mac in use; the test app never came to the front.
notExercised: The visual behaviour phase, which must run without the variable.
